title: FootFlex Terms and Conditions of Use & FAQs
content: Welcome to FootFlex. By accessing or using the FootFlex website, mobile web applications, or services, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. 1) User Account: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account. 2) Pricing & Product Representation: We strive for accurate product display, sizes, and pricing. In the event of a typographical or system pricing error, FootFlex reserves the right to cancel affected orders with full refund to the customer. 3) Intellectual Property: All content, logos, graphics, footwear designs, and software code are the exclusive property of FootFlex. 4) User Conduct: Unauthorized scrapers, bot attacks, fraudulent orders, or abusive language towards support staff are strictly prohibited. 5) Limitation of Liability: FootFlex shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from site usage. 6) Governing Law: These terms are governed by the laws of India, with exclusive jurisdiction in the courts of India.

faqs.question: What are the Terms and Conditions of using FootFlex?
faqs.answer: By using FootFlex, you agree to our Terms of Use regarding account responsibility, accurate product pricing, intellectual property protection, and lawful website usage.

faqs.question: Does FootFlex reserve the right to cancel an order due to pricing errors?
faqs.answer: Yes. If a technical error causes a product to display an incorrect price, FootFlex reserves the right to cancel the order and issue a full refund.

faqs.question: Who owns the images, graphics, and content on the FootFlex website?
faqs.answer: All logos, graphics, images, product photos, trademarks, and code belong exclusively to FootFlex and are protected under Indian intellectual property laws.

faqs.question: What happens if a user engages in fraudulent activity or fake orders?
faqs.answer: FootFlex reserves the right to immediately suspend or permanently terminate accounts engaging in fraudulent activities, fake return requests, or abuse.

faqs.question: Which legal jurisdiction governs FootFlex policies?
faqs.answer: All policies and terms are governed by the laws of India and subject to jurisdiction of Indian courts.
